_: ⭐⭐ THE FORCED-DEPTH SPY CAPTURE. `uncharted-volume-v2.pine` on AMEX:SPY 1D, read off the live rig on 2026-09-13 with the study holding 4,633 bars — comfortably past the 2,751-bar window its `HVE Trigger` declares. ⛔ IT SUPERSEDES `uncharted-volume-v2-spy-1d-2026-09-12.json`, which was taken on a chart holding ~640 bars and is now marked WINDOW_UNMEASURED.
_why_it_exists: ⚰️⚰️ THE SHALLOW CAPTURE GOT ONE COLUMN WRONG AND SAID SO CONFIDENTLY. At 640 bars `HVE Trigger` read FLAT 0 across the window, and that fixture recorded it as "correct, and useless as a test of the condition — it is the alertcondition, not a series." At 4,633 bars IT FIRES 25 TIMES. The reading was an artefact of the load, which is exactly what `tools/vendor_window.py` was written to catch, and this capture is the rail being right.

capture._gate: gate v2.1 PASS on the DRIVING tab before every click: visible, availTop -1446 <= screenY -1287, and -1287 + 1015 = -272 <= -54

how_the_depth_was_forced._: ⭐ RECORDED BECAUSE THE NEXT CAPTURE NEEDS IT. A fresh load of this layout gives ~640 bars, 2,111 short of the window. Two programmatic routes were tried first and BOTH FAILED: `chartWidget.setVisibleTimeRange(...)` throws `Error: Not implemented`, and `model.loadRange(from, to)` returns without error and loads nothing. ⛔ Neither is a forcing method, and a capture that trusted either would be shallow while looking driven.
how_the_depth_was_forced.method: The bottom-left Go to control (the icon right of the ALL range button) -> Date -> 2010-01-04 -> Go to.
how_the_depth_was_forced.result: chart 641 -> 4,523 bars, first 2008-09-18; the study then computed over 4,633 bars from 2008-04-14 (it reaches a little further back than the chart's own series).
how_the_depth_was_forced._do_not_use_ALL: ⚠️ The ALL range button switches the resolution to 1M — the documented trap. Go to keeps 1D.

source_receipt._: ⛔ THE EDITOR BUFFER WAS ALREADY THE COMMITTED SCRIPT, and it was hashed rather than assumed: 34,378 chars, LF, no CRLF, sha256 equal to the fixture file's. Nothing was typed or pasted for this capture.

monaco._re_derived: ⛔ RE-DERIVED THIS VISIT over 10,438 modules. It matches the id recorded on 2026-09-12 — a fact about this build, confirmed, never carried forward.
monaco._the_needle_was_wrong_first: ⚰️ THE FIRST DERIVATION RETURNED `899463` AND IT WAS A FALSE POSITIVE. Scanning module SOURCES for `editor.getModels` + `editor.create` matches any module that MENTIONS the API, and `899463` exports only `EditorBaseLayout`. The discriminator is the EXPORT — `typeof m.editor.getModels === 'function'` — which is this repo's 'code, never prose' rule one layer up: a source-text needle answers a question about text, not about what a module IS.

add_button_gate._zero_height: ⭐ THE ZERO-HEIGHT DUPLICATE IS THERE AGAIN — 93x24 and 93x0, the same pair as 2026-09-12. A gate without the height test counts two and stops.

plots._: The vendor's own roster from `metaInfo().plots`. ⛔ `plot_7` is typed `alertcondition` by TradingView itself, distinct from the four `line` plots — ruling D1, confirmed by the vendor a second time.
plots.value_array_layout: [time, plot_0, plot_1, plot_2, plot_3, plot_4, plot_5, plot_6, plot_7]
plots._align_on_time: ⛔⛔ ALIGN ON `time`, NEVER ON `date`. The 2026-09-12 capture carried a label a day out on bars_back 5, and a comparison keyed on it invented a 28% divergence.
plots._identical_to_the_shallow_capture: ⭐⭐ THE FOUR DRAWN SERIES ARE BYTE-FOR-BYTE WHAT THE 640-BAR CAPTURE READ, on all four rows. That is the per-column exclusion rule vindicated: `Volume` (window 0) and the three 50-bar columns were never at risk, and only the 2,751-bar column was. A rule that voided the whole capture would have thrown away four correct series.

Avg Vol Columns.note: a value on the last bar, null on the three below it — the two-tone cap only draws above the average

HVE Trigger.note: 0 on these four bars, and NOT flat across the series — see hve_trigger

hve_trigger._: ⭐⭐ THE COLUMN THE SHALLOW CAPTURE GOT WRONG. Over 4,633 bars it fires 25 times, on days a volume record is exactly what you would expect.
hve_trigger._sanity: 2010-05-06 is the Flash Crash; 2008-09-16/17/18 is the week Lehman failed; 2011-08-04/05/08/09 is the US downgrade. The firing set is not noise.

tables._: Read as STRINGS at the draw call — `CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.fillText` wrapped for one redraw and restored immediately (`restored: true` asserted in the same call). A screenshot cannot recover a trailing space and one cell has one.

volume_table._: ⭐ len 21 for 20 visible — the trailing space again, on a third capture.

chart_data_settings._: Read the same way as on the AGEN capture; adjustment is off, so nothing here is an adjusted series.

window_check._: ⭐ FULL_WINDOW, and this time the depth is a MEASUREMENT of the study itself — `study.data().size()`, not the chart's series length. Every field but `bars_loaded` is re-derived by `tests/test_vendor_capture_window.py`.

volume_granularity._: R-L: an integer series compares exactly AFTER the coarser side's granularity is applied.

teardown._: Nothing was saved. The chart keeps the forced history; the one authorised save of this wave was spent closing Part 0.
